name: Crispy and Flavorful Avocado Fries

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, lightly crush the panko with your hands until it is sandy in texture. Stir in tajín (if using), salt, and garlic powder. Drizzle in olive oil, mixing well to combine.

Halve and pit the avocados, then lay them, flat side down, on a clean work surface. Gently pull the peel back and discard. Slice each avocado lengthwise into 8 pieces. Working with one avocado slice at a time, dip in the lightly beaten egg to coat, then lift and allow excess to drip off. Transfer to the panko mixture and gently toss to coat well. Transfer to a platter and repeat with remaining avocado slices.

Preheat air fryer to 350ºF (175ºC) on the air fry setting. Place 8 avocado slices into the air fryer basket and cook, flipping halfway through, until the fries are crisp and golden brown all over, 8 minutes. Repeat with remaining avocado slices. Serve immediately, with dipping sauces if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: avocado fries, fried avocado, air fryer avocado fries

description: Crunchy with golden brown panko on the outside and buttery within, avocado fries are a low-effort, high-reward snack that come together in less than 30 minutes.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon Tajín (optional); Chipotle mayonnaise, ranch dressing, hot sauce, or other condiment, for serving (optional)

Notes: To make these fries in the oven, adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425ºF (220ºC). Bake avocado fries on a rimmed baking sheet for 18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crisp and golden brown.
author: Genevieve Yam
